SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURNING_POWER.title: Burning
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURNING_POWER.description: At the end of its turn, takes damage equal to Burning; Block melts twice as fast. Then Burning is halved.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURNING_POWER.smartDescri: At the end of its turn, takes [blue]{Amount}[/blue] fire damage (Block melts twice as fast). Then Burning is halved.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHILL_POWER.title: Chill
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHILL_POWER.description: At the start of its turn, loses Stamina equal to Chill. Then Chill is halved. Chilled enemies deal less attack damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHILL_POWER.smartDescript: At the start of its turn, loses [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Stamina. Then Chill is halved.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STATIC_POWER.title: Static
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STATIC_POWER.description: At the start of its turn, loses Mana equal to Static; any shortfall is dealt as shock damage. Then Static decreases by 1.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STATIC_POWER.smartDescrip: At the start of its turn, loses [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Mana; shortfall is dealt as shock damage. Then decreases by 1.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLEED_POWER.title: Bleed
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLEED_POWER.description: Whenever it attacks, loses HP equal to Bleed. Then Bleed decreases by 1.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLEED_POWER.smartDescript: Whenever it attacks, loses [blue]{Amount}[/blue] HP. Then decreases by 1.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PLATING_POWER.title: Plating
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PLATING_POWER.description: Each attack hit against it deals less damage (minimum 1).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PLATING_POWER.smartDescri: Each attack hit against it deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] less damage (minimum 1).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUNDER_POWER.title: Sunder
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUNDER_POWER.description: Reduces Plating. Below zero, each attack hit deals extra damage. Decreases by 1 each turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUNDER_POWER.smartDescrip: Plating reduced by [blue]{Amount}[/blue]. Below zero, attack hits deal extra damage.
